Night, cozy and cheerful, never spooky; no text.
panels: Rory the rabbit, in his red scarf and no costume yet, is the clear focus, large in the front: he sits up in his small round bed under the red-and-cream patchwork quilt in his cozy room, stretching both arms up with a big happy just-woke-up smile, his tall ears upright. Through the round window behind him a soft golden morning sun is rising over the green hills in a pale blue sky, and a small happy carved pumpkin, not lit yet, sits on the windowsill to show it is Halloween. Bright, fresh morning light fills the room.

Rory stands in the middle of his cozy room wearing his robot costume: the silver-grey cardboard box with just its yellow and green buttons, and the headband antenna with its little yellow ball between his tall upright ears, his red scarf at his neck. He holds both arms out stiff and straight like a robot, grinning. The robot costume is the clear focus; a roll of silver tape and a few cardboard scraps lie on the floor beside him. Through the round window the sky is a warm golden-orange dusk, and the pumpkin on the windowsill now glows.

Close and big: Rory, in his robot costume and red scarf, stands on the doorstep of his own home (the cream stone cottage, its arched wooden door under a small tiled porch roof behind him) at golden dusk, and holds up his small round orange candy bucket with both paws, beaming. Tied on its handle is the big, shiny bright red satin ribbon bow with two long wavy tails, the clear focus of the picture, glinting in the warm light of a glowing pumpkin on the step beside him and the orange-pink sunset sky.

The winding sandy-tan road is the clear focus, curving through soft green hills at night from the front of the picture into the distance, lined on both sides with happy glowing pumpkins. Rory, in his robot costume and red scarf, runs along the road with his orange bucket swinging. A big round full moon glows in the deep blue sky above.

The real robot is the clear focus, front and centre on the night road, in his rocket costume: the rounded white tube with its red band, two small red fins near his feet and round light-blue porthole, and the bright red pointed cone hat with his antenna poking out of its tip; his periwinkle face, arms and feet show. He stands tall with both arms pointing straight up like a rocket about to blast off, with a big proud smile. Rory, in his silver-grey cardboard robot costume, stands beside him laughing and pointing at him, so the two are plainly different: one a real periwinkle robot dressed as a rocket, one a rabbit dressed as a robot. The moon and glowing pumpkins are behind them.

The hedgehog's cottage on top of its little hill at night, framed so its big, tall, pointed bright red roof is the clear focus and fills the upper half of the picture, glowing warm in the moonlight, with the big full moon resting just on its peak. The pale lilac walls, round glowing yellow windows, round green front door and two happy pumpkins on the step sit lower and smaller beneath the roof. Rory, in his robot costume, and the robot, in his rocket costume, stand small on the path at the bottom, looking up at the red roof and smiling.

At the hedgehog's cottage's round green front door, set in its pale lilac wall, Rory, in his robot costume, tugs the short rope of the small round brass bell beside it. The bell is the clear focus, big and shining, swinging with little curved motion lines around it to show it is ringing. Rory holds out his orange bucket with its red ribbon bow and smiles; the robot in his rocket costume stands beside him; the happy pumpkins glow on the step.

Close up: the raisins are the clear focus. The kind old hedgehog stands in the open round green front door of the lilac cottage and tips the small plain purple box over Rory's orange bucket, and a little shower of wrinkled dark-brown raisins plops into it, a few bouncing on the rim. Rory, in his robot costume and red scarf, looks into his bucket with a delighted smile; the robot in his rocket costume peeks in too.

Close and low beside the moonlit road: the big smooth round grey rock is the clear focus, wide and close, filling the whole bottom third of the picture. Rory, in his robot costume and red scarf, sits on top of it resting, his orange bucket with its red ribbon bow standing on the rock beside him. Peeking over the rock's back edge, small and only from the eyes up, is a little white sheet ghost (Remy in his ghost costume): just the rounded top of the soft white sheet and its two round eye holes with his big friendly eyes, never scary. Rory's tall ears shoot straight up in happy surprise. No speech bubble. The robot in his rocket costume stands a little way off in the background, giggling, with the moon and glowing pumpkins along the road behind.

Remy the raccoon is the clear focus: the white sheet has slid back off his head onto his shoulders, showing his silver-grey face, dark slate-grey eye mask, big eyes and a huge cheeky grin, his bushy ringed tail curling out from under the sheet. Rory, in his robot costume, jumps up in the air beside him in surprise, laughing; the robot in his rocket costume claps. The big grey rock, the moon and glowing pumpkins are behind them.

Rory and Remy sit side by side on the big round grey rock, both laughing, the robot in his rocket costume beside them. Rory tips half of the raisins from his orange bucket into Remy's open paws; the little pile of wrinkled dark-brown raisins in Remy's paws is the clear focus. Remy wears his white sheet around his shoulders like a cape. The big full moon and glowing pumpkins are behind; warm and happy.

Rory the rabbit is the clear focus, tucked into his small round bed under the red-and-cream patchwork quilt in his cozy room, his red scarf still on, eyes closing with a sleepy happy smile, his tall ears resting on the pillow. His cardboard-box robot costume and antenna headband sit on the floor by the bed beside his orange bucket with its red ribbon bow. Through the round window the big full moon glows over the hills and the happy pumpkin glows on the sill.

bible: SID: a small, round, cuddly seagull, soft white-cream body with a pure white belly, pale blue-grey wings and a short blue-grey tail, big round friendly black eyes with rosy cheeks, a short yellow beak with a tiny red dot near the tip, little orange webbed feet. His signature accessory is a little round sailor cap: a white dome with a sky-blue band around it, sitting on top of his head. He stands about knee-high to Sadie. Around his neck he always wears a sky-blue sailor collar with a white stripe, tied in a small point at the front. For Halloween night Sid has a soft, round, bright orange pumpkin suit with gentle rounded ridges and a little ring of green leaves around the neck, worn around his body from his neck down to just above his feet, his blue-grey wings poking out of the sides and his orange webbed feet below; the suit has no face on it. With the suit on he keeps his sailor cap on top of his head, and his sailor collar shows just above the ring of leaves. Each scene says whether he is wearing the suit; when he is not, he wears only his cap and collar. THE SACK: a small, soft, bright purple cloth candy sack with a drawstring top and a white string; plain, with no writing or pictures on it. SADIE: a cheerful little girl about five years old, with dark brown hair in two pigtails, a sunny yellow sleeveless dress, and a wide straw-colored sun hat with a sky-blue ribbon band; bare feet or simple sandals. She is roughly three times Sid's height. Tonight Sadie is dressed as a friendly little witch, never scary: her straw sun hat is swapped for a tall, soft, pointed purple witch hat with a sky-blue ribbon band, she wears a short purple cape over her sunny yellow dress, and she carries a small toy broom. SAM: a round, plump, friendly grey clay seal with a pale belly, big dark eyes and whiskers. He is pale silver-grey and soft-looking all over, with a white muzzle, rosy cheeks and a small black nose. He is about twice Sid's height, about as tall as Sadie's waist. Tonight Sam wears a small white sheet draped over his head and back, with two round eye holes; his grey flippers, tail and whiskered nose always peek out from under it, so he is plainly a seal in a sheet, never a real ghost. THE GRANDMA: a kind, smiling grandmother who opens a cottage door, with a grey bun, round glasses and a green cardigan, holding a big orange bowl of colorful wrapped candies. THE PUMPKINS: carved pumpkins with happy smiling faces, glowing warm orange from inside. SETTING: Sid's little seaside village on a cozy, friendly Halloween night, in soft 3D clay style: a deep blue sky with a few twinkling stars, a big glowing full moon, a calm moonlit sea with small silver-white wave edges, warm golden sand, little cottages with warm lit windows, paper lanterns and glowing happy pumpkins along the paths. Lit warmly by the moon, the lanterns and the pumpkins; gentle and cheerful, never spooky. No text, letters or numbers anywhere in any picture.
cover: A square, cozy Halloween night cover. Sid the seagull, in his round orange pumpkin suit, his white-and-blue sailor cap and his sky-blue sailor collar, flies large in the center in front of a big glowing full moon, wings spread wide, smiling, his purple candy sack hanging by its string from one orange foot. Below, a calm moonlit sea and warm golden sand with a row of glowing happy carved pumpkins, and little cottages with warm lit windows at the edge of the beach. Warm, friendly and inviting, never spooky. No text, letters or numbers.
panels: A wide, warm evening view of the beach: a big, round, glowing orange sun sinks into the calm sea, painting the sky soft orange, pink and purple, with a shimmering golden path of light on the water. The setting sun is the clear focal point. Sid the seagull, in only his sailor cap and sailor collar, with no pumpkin suit, stands small on a wooden post at the water's edge, watching it go down with a happy face; two glowing happy carved pumpkins sit on the sand near the post.

Early Halloween night on the beach, the moon rising and the first stars out. Sid the seagull, in only his sailor cap and sailor collar, with no pumpkin suit yet, holds up his bright purple drawstring candy sack in one wing, beak open in an excited smile. The purple sack is big, clear and in the center of the picture; glowing happy pumpkins sit on the sand behind him.

Sid the seagull stands proudly on the moonlit sand showing off his new round, bright orange pumpkin suit with its ring of green leaves at the neck, wings flung out and one foot lifted in a silly pose, grinning, his sailor cap still on his head and his sky-blue sailor collar just above the leaves. The pumpkin suit is the clear focal point, big and bright in the middle of the picture; his purple sack lies on the sand beside him.

Sid the seagull, in his orange pumpkin suit and sailor cap, flies across a big glowing round full moon, wings spread wide and smiling, his purple sack hanging by its string from one orange foot. Sid is large, warmly lit and the clear focus, with the moon behind him; the calm moonlit sea and tiny lit cottages far below.

Seven carved pumpkins with happy smiling faces glow warmly in one neat, evenly spaced row on a low, rounded stone wall in front of a cottage, from small to big. Exactly seven pumpkins, all clearly visible and none hidden. Sid the seagull, in his pumpkin suit and sailor cap, perches on the end of the wall and waves a wing at them. The row of seven pumpkins is the focal point.

Sadie, in her tall purple witch hat with the sky-blue band, her short purple cape over her sunny yellow dress, holding her small toy broom, waves happily on a lantern-lit village path. Sid the seagull, in his pumpkin suit, stands on the path in front of her and waves back. Sadie is large, centered and the clear focus; friendly, not scary.

Sid the seagull and Sadie stand together on the doorstep of a cottage with a warm glowing door and a happy carved pumpkin beside it. Sid, front and center in his pumpkin suit and sailor cap, holds his purple sack wide open with both wings, beak open as he calls out cheerfully; Sadie, in her witch costume, smiles beside him. Sid is the clear focus.

A close, cozy view at the open cottage door: the kind grandma in her green cardigan tips colorful wrapped candies from her big orange bowl, and the candies fall through the air into Sid's open purple sack. The purple sack is big and the clear focal point in the center; Sid, in his pumpkin suit, holds it open with both wings, smiling widely.

On the moonlit beach path beside a glowing happy pumpkin, Sam the seal pops up hidden under his white sheet, flippers out wide, playfully saying boo; only his grey flippers, tail and whiskered nose peek out from under the sheet, with his eyes looking through the two round eye holes, so he is plainly a seal in a sheet. Sid, in his pumpkin suit, and Sadie, in her witch costume, lean back in surprise with round eyes and open mouths. The seal in the sheet is the clear focal point; funny and friendly, never scary.

The white sheet has slipped back off Sam the seal's head onto his shoulders, showing his round grey face, big dark eyes and whiskers as he laughs with his eyes squeezed shut. Sid the seagull, in his pumpkin suit, laughs with him, holding his tummy with his wings; Sadie giggles behind them. Sam is large, centered and the clear focus.

Sid the seagull in his pumpkin suit, Sadie in her witch costume, and Sam the seal with his sheet around his shoulders sit together on the warm golden sand by the calm moonlit sea, sharing colorful wrapped candies spread out on the sand from Sid's open purple sack. The wide stretch of golden sand fills the lower half of the picture and is the main thing to see; a glowing pumpkin and a paper lantern sit nearby.

Inside a tiny cozy beach hut, Sid the seagull, in only his sailor cap and sailor collar, is tucked into a small round bed under a sky-blue blanket, eyes half closed, sleepy and happy. His orange pumpkin suit hangs on a hook beside the bed and his purple sack rests on the floor. Through a round window, the full moon shines over the calm sea. Sid is the clear focus, warm and snug.

bible: LEON: a small round clay lion cub with golden fur, a fluffy orange mane and a big friendly smile. LEON'S HALLOWEEN COSTUME (pages 3 to 11 and the cover): a ladybug costume: a round, shiny red ladybug shell with big round black spots, worn on his back like a little rounded cape that covers him from his shoulders to his tail, held on by a soft black strap across his chest, plus a soft black headband with two bendy black antennae ending in little round black balls, sitting in his fluffy orange mane. His golden face, mane, paws and tail always show. On pages 1 and 2 he wears no costume; on page 12 the ladybug costume hangs on a hook by his bed. LUCKY: a small fluffy white puppy with a brown ear and a red collar. As drawn in the Leon's Lantern book, both of his floppy ears are brown, and a small round gold bell hangs from the front of his red collar. LUCKY'S HALLOWEEN COSTUME (pages 4 to 11 and the cover): a soft, round, bright yellow lemon suit shaped like a whole lemon lying on its side, with a small rounded point at the back above his wagging tail and one little green leaf on top, worn around his body; his white head, with his floppy brown ears and his red collar with its gold bell, pokes out of a round opening at the front, his four white paws show below and his tail wags out of the back. Lucky first appears on page 4; on page 12 he is out of the suit, and the lemon suit lies on the floor by the bed. THE LANTERN: an old-fashioned round lantern with a warm yellow glow. As drawn in the Leon's Lantern book, it is a brass lantern with glass sides, a little domed brass top and a ring handle on top. There is only ever one lantern. On page 1 it sits unlit on the little table beside Leon's bed. From page 2 on it is always with Leon and always glowing: usually he holds it up by its ring handle in one paw; when his paws are busy it stands on the ground right beside him (page 3 on the floor beside him, page 10 on the path beside him, page 11 on the grass in the middle of the friends' circle), and on page 12 it stands glowing softly on the little table beside his bed. THE BUCKET: a small, round, plain purple candy bucket with a handle, with no face, writing or pictures on it. There is only ever one bucket. From page 2 to page 11 it is always with Leon: usually he carries it by its handle in the paw that is not holding the lantern; when he sets it down it stands right beside him (page 2 at his feet, page 3 on the floor beside him, page 10 on the path beside him, page 11 open in the middle of the circle). It is not in the picture on page 1 or page 12. LIBBY: a small fluffy white clay lamb with a cream face, soft pink ears and little black hooves. As drawn in the Libby's Lemon book, her ears are big, soft and floppy, white with pink insides, and stick out at the sides of her head. LIBBY'S HALLOWEEN COSTUME (pages 9 to 11): a small, soft white sheet draped over her head and body, with two round eye holes through which her big, happy, shiny eyes peek out, so the holes are never empty or dark; her floppy pink-lined ears stick out through slits on each side, and her fluffy white legs and little black hooves always show below it, so she is plainly a lamb in a sheet, never a real ghost. On pages 10 and 11 the sheet has slipped back off her head onto her shoulders like a little cape, showing her cream face. THE KIND LADY: a kind, smiling lady with short curly brown hair, rosy cheeks, a cozy plum-purple cardigan over a long green dress, holding a big round orange bowl of colorful wrapped candies. THE PUMPKINS: carved pumpkins with happy smiling faces, glowing warm orange from inside. SETTING: a calm night by a lake with logs, big leaves, a starry dark blue sky, soft warm lantern light. Tonight is trick-or-treat night, in soft 3D clay style: a big glowing full moon over the calm lake, a little lakeside village of round cottages with warm lit windows and round wooden doors along a lake path, glowing happy carved pumpkins on doorsteps and logs, and soft piles of orange, red and gold autumn leaves. Lit warmly by the moon, the lantern and the pumpkins; gentle and cheerful, never spooky. No text, letters or numbers anywhere in any picture.
cover: A square, cozy trick-or-treat night cover. Leon the lion cub, in his red, black-spotted ladybug costume with the antennae headband in his fluffy orange mane, stands large in the center on the lake path, holding up his brass lantern glowing warm yellow in one paw and his purple candy bucket in the other, with a big friendly smile. Beside him, Lucky the white puppy, in his round bright yellow lemon suit, his floppy brown ears and gold collar bell showing, wags his tail. Behind them, a big glowing full moon over the calm lake, a happy carved pumpkin glowing on a log, a pile of autumn leaves and little cottages with warm lit windows. Warm, friendly and inviting, never spooky. No text, letters or numbers.
panels: Inside a cozy round cottage bedroom in the evening, Leon the lion cub, in no costume, has just woken from his nap: he sits up in his small bed and stretches his paws up high with a big happy yawn, his fluffy orange mane all tousled. Leon is large, centered and the clear focal point, plainly a lion cub. Through a round window, a big glowing full moon shines over the calm lake; his brass lantern, not yet lit, sits on the little table beside the bed.

Inside his cozy round cottage, Leon the lion cub, in no costume yet, stands by the little table and holds up his brass lantern by its ring handle, just lit and glowing with a warm yellow light, grinning with excitement; his empty purple candy bucket stands on the floor at his feet. The glowing lantern is big, bright and the clear focal point near the center of the picture. Through a round window behind him, happy carved pumpkins glow along the lake path under the full moon.

Leon the lion cub stands proudly in his cozy cottage showing off his new ladybug costume: the round, shiny red shell with big black spots on his back and the black antennae headband in his fluffy orange mane. He looks back over his shoulder at the spotted shell with a big proud grin, one paw on his hip. The red, black-spotted ladybug costume is the clear focal point, big and bright in the middle of the picture; his glowing lantern and his purple bucket stand on the floor beside him.

Lucky the white puppy, in his round bright yellow lemon suit with the little green leaf on top, trots in through the open cottage door, tail wagging and tongue out happily; his white head with his floppy brown ears and his red collar with its gold bell pokes out of the round opening at the front of the big lemon, with his four white paws below and his tail out of the back. Leon, in his ladybug costume, laughs beside him, holding his glowing lantern in one paw and his purple bucket in the other. Lucky in the lemon suit is large, centered and the clear focal point; funny and sweet.

A wide, calm view of the lake at night: the big glowing full moon shines in the deep blue starry sky and its silver reflection shimmers across the still lake water. The moonlit lake fills the middle of the picture and is the clear focal point. Small at the lake's edge, Leon in his ladybug costume walks along the path holding up his glowing lantern and his purple bucket, Lucky in his lemon suit trotting beside him; logs, big leaves and a few glowing happy pumpkins line the shore, and little cottages with lit windows sit across the water.

A long, thick fallen log lies across most of the foreground beside the lake path, big and brown with rough bark and a round cut end with tree rings facing us. The big fallen log is the largest thing in the picture and the clear focal point. A smaller carved pumpkin with a happy smiling face sits on top of the log near one end, glowing warm orange from inside. Just behind the log, Leon, in his ladybug costume, holding his glowing lantern and his purple bucket, and Lucky, in his lemon suit, stop and smile at the pumpkin on the log, Leon's lantern lighting them warmly.

Leon the lion cub, in his ladybug costume, stands front and center on the doorstep of a cozy round cottage with a warm glowing round door and a happy carved pumpkin beside it, holding out his open purple candy bucket in one paw and his glowing lantern in the other, mouth wide open as he calls out cheerfully. Lucky, in his lemon suit, wags his tail behind him. Leon is large, centered and the clear focus.

At the open round cottage door, the kind lady with short curly brown hair, rosy cheeks and her plum-purple cardigan leans down, smiling warmly, and tips colorful wrapped candies from her big round orange bowl into Leon's open purple bucket, the candies falling through the air. The kind lady is large and the clear focal point, warmly lit by the doorway; Leon, in his ladybug costume, holds up his bucket in one paw and his glowing lantern in the other with a huge grin, and Lucky, in his lemon suit, peeks in beside him.

On the lake path beside a glowing happy pumpkin, a big round pile of orange, red and gold autumn leaves bursts up, leaves flying everywhere, as a small figure in a white sheet jumps out of it with its front legs up in a playful boo; big, happy, shiny eyes peek out through the sheet's two round eye holes, floppy pink-lined ears stick out through slits on each side, and fluffy white legs and little black hooves show under the sheet, so it is plainly a lamb in a sheet. Leon, in his ladybug costume, and Lucky, in his lemon suit, lean back in surprise with round eyes and open mouths, Leon's lantern and bucket swinging in his paws. The big pile of flying autumn leaves is the clear focal point; funny and friendly, never scary.

The white sheet has slipped back off the lamb's head onto her shoulders like a little cape, showing Libby the lamb's cream face, big floppy pink-lined ears and big happy eyes as she laughs with her mouth wide open, a few autumn leaves stuck in her fluffy white wool. Libby the lamb is large, centered and the clear focal point. Leon, in his ladybug costume, laughs with her, holding his tummy with both paws, his glowing lantern and his purple bucket standing on the path beside him; Lucky, in his lemon suit, wags his tail.

Leon in his ladybug costume, Lucky in his lemon suit and Libby the lamb with her sheet around her shoulders sit in a cozy circle on the soft grass by the calm moonlit lake, around Leon's brass lantern standing on the grass in the middle, glowing warm yellow, sharing colorful wrapped candies spread out from the open purple bucket beside it. The glowing lantern is in the center of the picture and is the clear focal point, its warm light on all three happy faces; a happy pumpkin glows nearby.

Inside his cozy round cottage bedroom, Leon the lion cub, out of his costume, is tucked into his small bed under a soft orange blanket, eyes half closed, smiling sleepily, his fluffy orange mane on the pillow. His ladybug costume hangs on a hook by the bed; Lucky the puppy, out of his lemon suit, sleeps curled up at the foot of the bed with the lemon suit lying on the floor; and the brass lantern glows softly on the little table beside the bed. Through the round window, the full moon shines over the lake. Leon is large, centered and the clear focus, warm and snug.

bible: ZOE: a small, round, cute young zebra who stands and walks upright on two legs like a toddler; creamy off-white body with soft charcoal-black stripes, a short spiky black mane, a dark grey muzzle, big round dark friendly eyes, little dark-grey hooves for hands and feet, a short tail with a black tuft, and a bright pink bow on top of her head (she always wears the bow). Tonight she does not wear her lavender coat. ZOE'S HALLOWEEN COSTUME (pages 3 to 11 and the cover): a silly zucchini suit: a long, soft, puffy dark-green suit shaped like a fat zucchini standing on end, with pale-green speckled stripes running from top to bottom, worn from her shoulders down to her knees, with a soft hood that covers the top and back of her head and rises into a rounded zucchini tip with a short knobbly brown stem sticking up from the very top; her whole face shows through a big round opening in the hood, and while she wears the suit her pink bow is clipped to the front edge of the hood just above her face (the bow is always there, in the same place); her striped arms poke out of two holes in the sides and her striped legs and hooves show below. One long zipper runs down the middle of the front, from the bottom hem up to the bottom of the face opening, with a bright yellow zipper pull. The suit has no face on it. On pages 1 and 2 she wears no costume, only her pink bow on top of her head; on page 12 the suit hangs on a hook on the wall and the bow is back on top of her head. THE BUCKET: a small, round orange candy bucket with a black handle; plain, with no face, writing or pictures on it. THE CANDY: small wrapped candies in bright red, yellow, blue and green wrappers. ZACK THE ZOOKEEPER: a kind, smiling grown-up man, about twice Zoe's height, with warm tan skin and short brown hair under a dark green baseball cap; he wears a khaki short-sleeved zookeeper shirt with a small tan chest pocket, dark green trousers and brown boots. ZACK'S HUT: a small round-roofed wooden zookeeper hut beside the zoo path, with a green front door, one warm lit window and a single wooden step; no signs or writing. THE LITTLE ZEBRA: a tiny, round baby zebra about half Zoe's height who stands and walks upright on two legs like Zoe, with little dark-grey hooves for hands and feet; creamy off-white with soft charcoal-black stripes, a fluffy short black mane, a dark grey muzzle, big dark friendly eyes, rosy cheeks and a short tail with a black tuft; no bow. ITS HALLOWEEN COSTUME: a small white sheet over its head and back, reaching down to its middle, with two round eye holes through which its big dark friendly eyes peek; its striped arms, striped legs and tufted tail stick out below the sheet, so it is plainly a little zebra in a sheet, never a real ghost. ZOE'S LITTLE HOUSE: a cozy wooden zebra house inside the zoo, with one round window, a round-topped plain light-wood front door (never green), a low bed of soft golden straw with a lavender-purple blanket, and a wooden hook on the wall. THE PUMPKINS: round carved pumpkins with happy smiling faces, glowing warm orange from inside. SETTING: the same gentle, cheerful zoo, now on a cozy, friendly Halloween night, in soft 3D clay style: soft green grass, a sandy-beige path, rolling green hills, a rounded leafy tree, and the wooden zoo entrance arch made of two brown posts topped by a curved green arch decorated with a yellow circle and small orange and blue circles (no words or signs on it), tonight hung with a string of glowing round paper lanterns. A deep blue night sky with a few twinkling stars and a big glowing full moon; glowing happy pumpkins line the sandy path. Lit warmly by the moon, the lanterns and the pumpkins; gentle and cheerful, never spooky. No text, letters or numbers anywhere in any picture.
cover: A square, cozy Halloween night cover. Zoe the zebra, in her silly dark-green zucchini suit with its hood up, the rounded zucchini tip and knobbly brown stem on top, her whole face showing through the round opening and her pink bow clipped to the front edge of the hood just above her face, the bright yellow zipper pull zipped all the way up to the face opening, stands large in the centre of the sandy zoo path, cheering with one hoof raised high and her small orange candy bucket in the other, a big happy smile. Behind her, the wooden zoo arch with its curved green top hung with glowing paper lanterns, a big glowing full moon in a deep blue starry sky, rolling green hills and a leafy tree, and a row of glowing happy carved pumpkins along the path. Warm, friendly, funny and inviting, never spooky. No text, letters or numbers.
panels: Inside her cozy little zebra house in the early evening, Zoe the zebra (no costume, only her pink bow on top of her head) sits up on her soft golden straw bed with the lavender-purple blanket slipping off, stretching both arms up and opening her big eyes as she wakes from her nap with a happy face. The whole zebra is large and centred, her black-and-white stripes clear and bold: she is the clear focal point. Through the round window behind her, a dusky deep-blue evening sky with the first twinkling stars and a big full moon rising.

Zoe the zebra (no costume, only her pink bow on top of her head) stands in the open round-topped front doorway of her little house, seen from the side, holding up her small orange candy bucket with an excited smile as she looks out. Beyond her, filling most of the picture: the Halloween zoo on a cozy night, with the wooden zoo arch and its curved green top hung with glowing paper lanterns, glowing happy carved pumpkins along the sandy path, rolling green hills, a leafy tree and a big glowing full moon in a deep blue starry sky; a friendly giraffe small in the far background. The lantern-lit zoo is the main thing to see.

Inside her cozy little house, Zoe the zebra stands proudly in the middle wearing her new zucchini suit for the first time: the long, puffy dark-green zucchini with pale-green speckled stripes, its hood up with the rounded zucchini tip and knobbly brown stem on top, her whole face showing through the round opening and her pink bow clipped to the front edge of the hood just above her face. She strikes a silly pose, striped arms flung out wide and one hoof lifted, grinning and giggling. The front of the suit hangs open, the bright yellow zipper pull waiting at the bottom, showing her striped tummy. The zucchini suit is big, bright and the clear focal point; her orange bucket waits on the floor and the moon shines through the round window.

Close view of Zoe the zebra in her zucchini suit, pulling the bright yellow zipper pull upward with one hoof and a determined little smile. The long zipper down the front of the dark-green suit is the clear focus, large and sharp in the centre: zipped closed from the bottom hem up to her chest, with small white motion lines beside the yellow pull to show it zipping up. Above, her face in the round opening of the hood, her pink bow clipped to the front edge of the hood and the brown stem on top; warm lamplight from her little house.

Zoe the zebra, in her zipped-up zucchini suit, runs very fast along the sandy zoo path at night, leaning forward mid-stride with her striped legs stretched out, her pink bow fluttering and her orange candy bucket swinging from one hoof, white speed lines streaming behind her to show she is zooming. A big round glowing full moon fills the deep blue sky above her, and glowing happy pumpkins line the path. Zoe zooming is large and the clear focus.

Zack the zookeeper (dark green cap, khaki shirt with a tan chest pocket, dark green trousers, brown boots) stands large and centred in the open green front doorway of his little hut, warm light behind him, smiling warmly and holding up a big carved pumpkin with a happy face that glows warm orange from inside, its light shining on his face. Zoe the zebra in her zucchini suit stands small on the sandy path below the wooden step, looking up at the glowing pumpkin with delight. Zack holding the glowing pumpkin is the clear focus.

Zoe the zebra in her zucchini suit stands front and centre on the sandy path at the foot of Zack's little hut, holding her orange candy bucket out with both hooves, mouth open wide as she calls out cheerfully. The glowing happy carved pumpkin now sits on the wooden step beside her. Behind her, Zack the zookeeper is still in the open green doorway with warm light spilling out, smiling down at her, smaller in the picture. Zoe is large and the clear focus.

Zack the zookeeper, large and centred, bends down in the warm lit doorway of his hut, smiling kindly, and drops a small handful of colorful wrapped candies into Zoe's small orange bucket. Zoe the zebra, in her zucchini suit, holds the bucket up with a wide smile, smaller at the front. The candies are small; Zack, kind and smiling, is the clear focus.

On the moonlit zoo path, a small round ghost pops out from behind a big glowing happy pumpkin with its little striped arms out wide, playfully saying boo: a small white sheet over its head and back with two round eye holes and big dark friendly eyes peeking through, and small black-and-white striped arms, striped legs and a striped tail with a black tuft sticking out below the sheet, so it is plainly a little zebra in a sheet. Zoe the zebra in her zucchini suit, large in the front, jumps up in surprise with both hooves off the ground, eyes round and mouth open in an O, her candy bucket swinging. Funny and friendly, never scary; Zoe jumping is the clear focus.

The white sheet has slipped back off the head of the tiny baby zebra onto its shoulders, showing its round striped face, fluffy short black mane, big dark eyes and rosy cheeks as it giggles with its eyes squeezed shut, standing upright on its two little striped legs. Zoe the zebra in her zucchini suit laughs beside it, holding her tummy. The little zebra is large, centred and the clear focus, its black-and-white stripes bold and clear; a glowing pumpkin and the moonlit path behind.

Zoe the zebra in her zucchini suit and the little zebra, with the white sheet around its shoulders, sit together on the soft grass beside the sandy zoo path under the big glowing moon, sharing colorful wrapped candies poured out of the orange bucket between them. Zoe, large and in the front, holds out a candy to the little zebra with a warm smile. A glowing happy pumpkin and a paper lantern sit nearby. Zoe is the clear focus.

Inside her cozy little zebra house, Zoe the zebra, out of her costume with only her pink bow on top of her head, is tucked into her soft golden straw bed under the lavender-purple blanket, eyes half closed, sleepy and happy, her black-and-white stripes clear. Her zucchini suit hangs on the wooden hook on the wall and her orange bucket sits on the floor. Through the round window, the full moon shines over the lantern-lit zoo arch. Zoe the zebra is large and the clear focus, warm and snug.

bible: FINN: a small, round, friendly fish, drawn the way he looks in the Finn Finds a Feather book: usually seen from the front or a three-quarter view, often swimming toward the right, with a big round pale-cream face, two big glossy dark eyes with white sparkles, two pink cheeks and a small open smile with a little pink tongue; a round, bright orange body with two broad white vertical stripes edged in darker orange (one just behind his face, one near his tail); golden-yellow side fins that he uses like little hands to wave and to hold things, a golden-yellow top fin and a forked golden-yellow tail. On Halloween night Finn wears his fairy costume, and nothing else, unless a scene says he wears no costume: a pair of see-through pale-lilac fairy wings with thin silver edges, shaped like a butterfly's, tied on his back just behind his first white stripe, and a tiny silver fairy crown with one little silver star on top, sitting on the top of his head. When Finn is at the surface he pokes his head and fins up out of the water; he stays in the water unless a scene says he jumps or leaps. THE BUCKET: a small, round, bright orange pumpkin-shaped candy bucket with a short green stem and a black handle, with a big funny face drawn on the front in black: two round googly eyes looking different ways and a wide goofy grin with a little pink tongue poking out. The face is only drawn on; the bucket is not alive. Finn carries it with its handle hooked over one golden-yellow side fin. THE FUDGE: small soft squares of chocolate-brown fudge, each a little cube with rounded edges and a glossy top, plain, with no face, unwrapped, each about the size of Finn's eye. FAY: a cute young fox who stands upright on two legs, bright orange fur, white belly, white muzzle and white tip on her bushy tail, dark-brown pointed ear tips, dark-brown paws and feet, big friendly eyes; no clothes except, tonight, her ghost costume: a plain white sheet with two round eye holes, through which her big friendly eyes always peek out, so the holes are never empty or dark, draped over her head and body down to her knees, with her big bushy orange tail with its white tip and her dark-brown feet always poking out below it, so she is plainly a fox in a sheet, never a real ghost. When a scene says the sheet has slipped off her head, it hangs around her shoulders like a little cape. She is about twice Finn's height. THE DUCK FAMILY: one cream-white mother duck with soft beige wings and an orange bill and feet, plus three small, fluffy, bright-yellow ducklings with orange bills, each about half her size. Tonight all four are dressed as bats: each wears a little headband with two pointy black bat ears and a pair of small black felt bat wings tied on its back over its own wings; friendly and smiling, never scary. THE GULL: a round, friendly seagull, white head and body, soft grey-blue wings, a short yellow-orange beak, pink cheeks, yellow-orange feet, about the size of Fay; no costume. THE PUMPKINS: carved pumpkins with happy smiling faces carved into them, glowing warm orange from inside; they are not alive, and they sit only on the shore and the dock, never in the water. SETTING: Finn's corner of the sea on a cozy, friendly Halloween night. Under the water the sea is a clear, soft moonlit blue, bright enough to see everything, never murky or dark, with soft green kelp swaying, a big smooth grey rock on the sandy floor (Finn's home), rising bubbles and soft silver moonbeams slanting down from above. At the surface, calm blue water with gentle ripples meets a grassy green shore with a little wooden dock on posts, a few small cottages with warm lit windows, and lanterns on posts; above, a deep blue sky with a few twinkling stars and a big glowing full moon that lays a shimmering silver path on the water. Lit warmly by the moon, the lanterns and the pumpkins; gentle and cheerful, never spooky. No text, letters or numbers anywhere in any picture.
cover: A square, cozy Halloween night cover. Finn the fish, in his see-through pale-lilac fairy wings and tiny silver star crown, leaps up out of the calm moonlit sea in a happy little splash, large and in the center, grinning at the viewer, his orange funny-face pumpkin bucket hooked on one golden-yellow fin. Behind him a big glowing full moon in a deep blue sky with a few twinkling stars, and a shimmering silver moon path on the water. Along the grassy shore at one side, a row of glowing happy carved pumpkins and a little cottage with warm lit windows; just below the waterline, green kelp, bubbles and the top of his big smooth grey rock. Warm, friendly and inviting, never spooky. No text, letters or numbers.
panels: Night under the sea: Finn the fish, with no costume, floats beside his big smooth grey rock on the sandy floor, facing us, just waking up: his big glossy eyes are half open and he gives a small happy yawn, a few sleepy bubbles rising from his mouth. Soft silver moonbeams slant down through the clear moonlit blue water from above. Finn is large, centered and the clear focal point, so the picture plainly shows one fish; green kelp sways at both edges. No other animals.

Under the moonlit sea beside his big grey rock, Finn the fish shows off his new fairy costume: see-through pale-lilac fairy wings with thin silver edges tied on his back, and his tiny silver star crown on his head. He turns to look back at his wings with a delighted grin, one side fin lifted proudly. The fairy wings are big, bright and the clear focal point. Moonbeams, green kelp and a few bubbles behind him; no other animals.

A close view under the moonlit sea: Finn, in his fairy wings and star crown, holds up his orange candy bucket by its handle hooked over one golden-yellow side fin, and the bucket's big funny face fills the middle of the picture: two round googly eyes looking different ways and a wide goofy grin with a little pink tongue poking out. Finn giggles at it. The funny face on the bucket is the clear focal point; soft blue water and kelp behind.

At the calm surface of the moonlit sea, Finn, in his fairy wings and star crown, pokes his head out of the water and lifts one golden-yellow side fin high to wave at a big glowing full moon in the deep blue sky, smiling up at it. His raised, waving fin is large, close and clearly the focus at the front of the picture, with the round moon behind it, a shimmering silver moon path on the water and small ripples ringing around him; his orange bucket hangs from his other fin. A few stars twinkle.

At the water's edge, exactly five carved pumpkins with happy smiling faces glow warm orange in one neat, evenly spaced row on smooth rocks along the grassy shore, from small to big. Exactly five pumpkins, all clearly visible and none hidden, and no other pumpkins anywhere in the picture. Finn, in his fairy wings and star crown, peeks out of the calm moonlit water in front of them with a happy face, his orange bucket on his fin. The row of five pumpkins is the clear focal point.

On the calm moonlit water near the shore, the duck family swims past in one neat row, all four dressed as bats: the cream-white mother duck in front and three small yellow ducklings behind her, each wearing a little headband with pointy black bat ears and small black felt bat wings on its back, all smiling. The whole duck family is large, together and the clear focus. Finn, in his fairy wings and star crown, peeks up from the water at the left edge, grinning at them, his orange bucket on his fin.

Beside the little wooden dock, Finn the fish, in his fairy wings and star crown, bounces up at the water's surface, holding his orange funny-face bucket high on his fin and calling out cheerfully with his mouth wide open. The gull stands on top of one dock post, leaning down to listen with a kind smile; on the dock boards at the foot of that post sits a small orange bowl of chocolate fudge squares. Further along the dock, a glowing happy pumpkin and a lantern on its own post. Finn is large, at the front and the clear focus; a cottage with warm lit windows on the shore behind.

A close, cozy view at the dock: the gull leans down from the edge of the dock and lets two squares of chocolate-brown fudge tumble from his beak, and they drop through the air into Finn's open orange bucket, which is empty until now. The two falling fudge squares are large, glossy and the clear focal point in the center. Below, Finn, in his fairy wings and star crown, holds the bucket up out of the water on his fin, smiling widely.

On the moonlit grassy shore at the water's edge, beside a glowing happy pumpkin, Fay the fox, completely hidden under her white ghost sheet with her big friendly eyes peeking out of its two round eye holes, pops up with her arms raised in a playful boo; under the hem of the sheet her big bushy bright-orange furry tail with its white tip sticks out, with her two dark-brown feet. The furry orange tail is large, bright and the clear focal point, so a child can tell the ghost is someone in a sheet. Finn, in his fairy wings and star crown, his orange funny-face bucket hooked on one fin, peeks out of the water with round eyes and an open mouth in surprise. Funny and friendly, never scary.

The white sheet has slipped back off Fay the fox's head onto her shoulders, showing her bright orange face, white muzzle and dark-brown pointed ear tips as she laughs with her eyes squeezed shut, standing at the edge of the grassy shore. Beside her, Finn, in his fairy wings and star crown, has jumped right up out of the water in a happy splash with droplets flying, laughing too, his orange funny-face bucket still hooked on one fin. Fay the fox is large, centered and the clear focus.

Fay the fox, with her white sheet around her shoulders, sits on the edge of the little wooden dock with her dark-brown feet dangling over the water, and Finn, in his fairy wings and star crown, pops up from the water right beside her. His orange funny-face bucket sits on the dock between them, and each of them holds up one square of chocolate-brown fudge, smiling at each other. The two fudge squares are big, clear and the main thing to see. The full moon shines on the calm water; a glowing happy pumpkin and a lantern sit on the dock.

Back under the sea beside his big smooth grey rock, Finn the fish, with no costume, sleeps snuggled in a soft nest of green kelp, eyes closed in a contented smile, a few tiny sleepy bubbles rising. His fairy wings and tiny star crown rest on top of the rock, and his orange bucket sits on the sand beside him. Soft silver moonbeams slant gently down through the clear moonlit blue water. Finn is large, centered and the clear focus, warm and snug; no other animals.
